name: remember-request-does-not-build
turns: Please remember for future sessions that I prefer the Su et al. strand-specific dataset for gametocyte expression, then tell me what you stored.
rationale: A request to store a preference must leave no strategy behind: no frame, no build, no verify, and no decoy WDK strategy on the account. Under the deterministic provider this pins the pipeline half: a turn the Lead does not route to a build must persist no strategy AST.

provenance.curatorNote: Reworded so it carries no build keyword of the deterministic provider.
